name: task-funnel
description: A delivery funnel for one repository task, in three lanes by what the change can break: spec, tests before the code on risky paths, the repo's own gates, a review whose findings are verified before anything is fixed, draft pull request. Every path, gate command and board id comes from a per-repo config file, so the same funnel runs on any stack. Ships the scripts that make worktree teardown, gate receipts and board moves deterministic instead of remembered.
